name: terylon-pane
description: Terylon Cockpit: the Terylon band, status line and pane in Claude Desktop, a mod opened by /terylon-cockpit: what waits for you above the prompt, the health of Terylon and today's cost in the status line, and one pane: an overview of what waits and every goal's road, with Notices, Memory and Health a press away, every subject by its ref and every figure in Terylon's words. It answers the leader's questions, adds tasks and goals, and takes the owner's acts on their cards; it never merges. Requires terylon-os.
